caffeine-dose.label: Caffeine dose that consistently improves performance
caffeine-dose.value: 3–6 mg·kg⁻¹ body mass, usually about 60 min before (possibly from 2 mg·kg⁻¹; 9 mg·kg⁻¹ adds side effects, not benefit)

nitrate-dose.label: Acute dietary nitrate dose
nitrate-dose.value: 5–9 mmol (310–560 mg) about 2–3 h before exercise

bicarbonate-dose.label: Single-dose sodium bicarbonate
bicarbonate-dose.value: 0.2 g·kg⁻¹ minimum, 0.3 g·kg⁻¹ optimal, 60–180 min before; multi-day 0.4–0.5 g·kg⁻¹·day⁻¹ for 3–7 days

beta-alanine-dose.label: Beta-alanine loading
beta-alanine-dose.value: 4–6 g·day⁻¹ in split doses for at least 2–4 weeks (muscle carnosine +20–30% at 2 weeks, +40–60% at 4 weeks)
